summary: Bug regression verified: Final Approval permission bug for kl.srivastava@arunenterprises.online is FIXED. Executed full end-to-end flow: (1) logged in as super admin, created an approved vendor (AE0001JV2627) and a bill (AE00202627) advanced through steps 1→2→3→4 (Mgmt Approval). (2) Logged out, logged in as approver kl.srivastava@arunenterprises.online / Kl@2026 — verified localStorage AUTH.user field correctly holds the approver email. (3) Clicked Final Approval on the step-4 bill — NO permission-denied toast appeared, bill advanced to '5. Payment Due List', approverName field was auto-stamped 'K L Srivastava', and success toast 'Final Approval · Added to Due List · Net ₹11600' shown. (4) Also confirmed super admin can perform Vendor Final Approval with no permission error. (5) Verified canFinalApprove() correctly rejects a non-approver email in-browser.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by editor instrumentation wrapping option children; harmless at runtime but pollutes console. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: currentUserEmail() in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js line 408 now reads AUTH.user (which is where login() writes the email at line 377) instead of AUTH.email. Same pattern consistently applied in UsersAdmin/TopActionBar/TopNav.

Data model note: The AUTH object uses key 'user' to hold the email string — semantic mismatch (a key named 'user' typically holds a full object). Consider renaming to `email` in a future refactor (writing both keys + reading both for backward compat) so that the field name matches its content, preventing this class of bug from re-occurring.

rca of the issue: Root cause: login() in store.js writes AUTH as {user: email, name, role, at}, but currentUserEmail() was reading AUTH.email which was undefined → canFinalApprove('') returned false always → permission toast for every user (including approver). Fix: change currentUserEmail() to read AUTH.user. Reproduction (pre-fix): log in as approver → open /bill → load a step-4 bill → click Final Approval → see toast 'Final Approval permission only for kl.srivastava@... or Super Admin'. Mitigation: applied fix to currentUserEmail() at store.js:408 + same pattern in UsersAdmin/TopActionBar/TopNav. Verified in this iteration.
